module_summary: Source half of a gray-code CDC FIFO: a pointer child handles handshake and gray write pointer, a data child stores words written on valid&ready.

anchors.name: src_valid_i
anchors.why: Source valid; with ready forms the write strobe and advances the write pointer.

anchors.name: src_ready_o
anchors.why: Source ready from pointer child's full comparison; gates writes.

anchors.name: src_data_i
anchors.why: Source data written into the FIFO storage child.

anchors.name: async_data_o
anchors.why: FIFO storage array exposed asynchronously to the destination domain.

anchors.name: async_wptr_o
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer sent to the destination domain.

anchors.name: async_rptr_i
anchors.why: Gray read pointer from destination, synchronized for full detection.

anchors.name: src_write
anchors.why: Write enable into storage child when valid and ready.

anchors.name: src_widx
anchors.why: Binary write index from pointer child addressing the storage array.

groups.name: src_pointer
groups.description: Gray write pointer, read-pointer synchronizer and full-based ready generation.

groups.name: src_storage
groups.description: Register array written at src_widx on src_write, read asynchronously.
